name: openAnchored
type: (component: Type<T>, anchor: HTMLElement, options?: OverlayOptions) => OverlayHandle<T, R>
description: Opens a CDK overlay anchored to a trigger element with automatic outside-click and Escape dismissal.

name: openGlobal
description: Opens a globally positioned overlay centered or corner-anchored in the viewport.

name: close
description: Closes an active OverlayHandle and emits the optional result on closed$.
